items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know one of my dear buddies, Jimmy Allen was his name, and we were just really tight.

ctx.x: Younger guys, yeah. Well that‟s happening today.

Of course, it happens to me [laughter]. I‟ve seen it happen so I understand it. But I can remember distinctly, and I remember this because I love to repeat it. One day… it was New Year‟s Eve. Everybody can get a gig New Year‟s Eve. There ain‟t enough musicians to go around New Year‟s Eve. They run out of bass players and they asked me and I was busy. I remember I was up at the union. Walter Wright was serving drinks. This guy said, “Hey, Walter, you want to make this gig tonight”? And he said in that southern…
